I feel pity for you but my honest opinion is this video is not motivating for everyone. Your video is demotivating to anyone who is enthusiastically preparing well for Google/Facebook on-site. Instead you could have given a deeper thought of where things could have gone wrong in your interviews. No one rejects candidates without strong reason. You think you gave a good solution but you might not have given the most optimal solution, or well structured code, or not have communicated the approach well or not have asked the right questions/stated assumptions, thought about corner cases.etc. If you found out what your fault actually was and shared it, everyone could have benefited from that. If you keep thinking you made no mistake and you still got rejected, how will you learn from any of those failures!
